Title: CRM-003 — Partner onboarding wizard (6-step, manual entry, no AI)
Description:
## CRM-003 — Partner onboarding wizard (6-step, manual entry, no AI)

**Goal:** Multi-step form at `/partner/onboarding` that collects the partner's business profile. All fields filled manually — no Places API autofill, no AI co-pilot. Progress auto-saved to `partner_drafts.payload` on every step advance. Step 6 activates the partner.

> Phase 2 note: AI business autofill (Places API → HITL confirm) and onboarding co-pilot will be added in SAN-800 (PTR-AI-001) after CopilotKit v2 migration.

---

## Route

`/partner/onboarding?step=[1-6]`

Progress bar at top (step N of 6). Back/Next navigation. Each step saves partial payload before advancing.

---

## Steps

### Step 1 — Business info

Fields: `business_name` (required), `description` (textarea, min 50 chars suggested), `phone`, `website`, `instagram`

Validation: `business_name` required before advancing.

### Step 2 — Location

Fields: `address` (text), `neighborhood` (select: El Poblado / Laureles / El Centro / Envigado / Sabaneta / Other), `city` (default: Medellín)

For venue/rental types, additional: `capacity_min`, `capacity_max`

### Step 3 — Services + pricing

Dynamic list of services. Each: `name`, `description`, `price_from`, `price_to`, `unit` (hour/event/month/person)

Add/remove service rows. Min 1 service required to advance.

For venue types: `price_per_hour` prominently shown.

### Step 4 — Availability

Weekly schedule grid: Mon–Sun × open/close times. Toggle day on/off. Saved as `partner_locations.availability` JSON.

### Step 5 — Photos

Upload ≥ 1 photo (min recommended: 3). Supabase Storage upload → `partner_assets` rows.
Photo reorder via drag-and-drop. Mark primary photo.

### Step 6 — Review + activate

Summary of all entered info (read-only). Completion percentage displayed.
"Activate my profile" button → calls activate endpoint.

---

## Auto-save

Every step advance: `PATCH /api/partner/drafts/[draftId]` with current step payload.
Partial data never lost. On return visit to `/partner/onboarding`, resume from `partner_drafts.step`.

---

## Activate endpoint: `POST /api/partner/activate`

```ts
// Reads partner_drafts.payload → validates required fields
// Updates partner_organizations: status → 'active', populates all fields
// Creates partner_locations row (if applicable)
// Creates partner_services rows
// Calls compute_partner_completion_pct() RPC → updates profile_completion_pct
// Returns: { partnerId, redirectUrl: '/partner/dashboard' }
```

---

## Completion score

After each step save, call `compute_partner_completion_pct()` and display as progress bar in the wizard header. No Gemini narrative — just the number.

---

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All 6 steps render with correct fields for all 18 partner types
- [ ] Venue/rental types show capacity + hourly pricing fields
- [ ] Auto-save on every step advance (verified by refreshing mid-wizard)
- [ ] Return visit resumes from correct step
- [ ] Photo upload works → `partner_assets` rows created
- [ ] Completion score updates after each step
- [ ] Activate converts draft → `partner_organizations.status = 'active'`
- [ ] Post-activation redirect to `/partner/dashboard`
- [ ] Vitest: activate endpoint validates required fields, creates all rows
- [ ] Playwright: full 6-step wizard → activate → dashboard redirect

## Blocked by

* CRM-001 (schema), CRM-002 (signup creates draft)

## Blocks

* CRM-005 (dashboard requires active partner)

Title: CRM-002 — Partner signup + auth flow
Description:
## CRM-002 — Partner signup + auth flow

**Goal:** `/partner/signup` route where a new partner selects their type, creates an account (Supabase Auth), and is redirected to the onboarding wizard. Existing users signing up as partners skip the auth step.

---

## Routes (check sitemap before implementing)

* `/partner/signup` — public, leads to `/partner/onboarding`
* `/partner/login` — public, redirects to `/partner/dashboard` on success
* `/partner/dashboard` — protected, redirects to `/partner/onboarding` if no active `partner_organizations` record

---

## Signup flow

```
1. /partner/signup
   └─ Step A: "What type of business?" (18 partner type cards with icons)
   └─ Step B: "Create your account" (email + password)
        ↓ supabase.auth.signUp()
        ↓ INSERT partner_organizations { user_id, type, status: 'draft' }
        ↓ INSERT partner_drafts { user_id, partner_id, step: 1, status: 'in_progress' }
        ↓ redirect → /partner/onboarding?step=1

2. If user already authenticated:
   └─ Skip Step B, go directly to partner type → partner_organizations insert

3. /partner/login (existing partners)
   └─ email + password → supabase.auth.signInWithPassword()
   └─ check: has active partner_organizations record?
      yes → /partner/dashboard
      no  → /partner/onboarding (resume from last draft step)
```

---

## Partner type cards

18 types rendered as a 3×6 or 4×5 grid. Each card: icon + label. Types:
`venue_owner`, `real_estate`, `restaurant`, `cafe`, `nightclub`, `event_host`, `sponsor`, `photographer`, `dj`, `band`, `catering`, `bar_service`, `security`, `transportation`, `flowers`, `marketing`, `legal`, `other`

---

## API route: `POST /api/partner/signup`

```ts
// Creates partner_organizations + partner_drafts transactionally
// Returns: { partnerId, draftId, redirectUrl }
// Uses service-role key (server-only, F13 carve-out) to insert after auth.signUp() resolves
```

---

## Middleware guard

`src/middleware.ts` — add `/partner/dashboard/*` to protected routes. Redirect to `/partner/login` if no session.

---

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `/partner/signup` type selection step renders all 18 types
- [ ] Email/password signup creates Supabase auth user + partner_organizations row
- [ ] On success, redirected to `/partner/onboarding?step=1`
- [ ] Existing user signing up as partner skips auth step
- [ ] `/partner/login` authenticates + redirects correctly
- [ ] Middleware blocks `/partner/dashboard/*` for unauthenticated users
- [ ] `partner_organizations.status = 'draft'` on creation (not 'active' yet)
- [ ] Vitest: signup API creates both records transactionally
- [ ] Playwright: full signup → onboarding redirect flow

* CRM-001 (schema must exist)

## Blocks

* CRM-003 (wizard starts after signup redirect)

Title: CRM-001 — Partner schema + RLS foundation (all 9 tables)
Description:
## CRM-001 — Partner schema + RLS foundation (all 9 tables)

**Goal:** Single migration that creates the complete partner data model. Every table ships with RLS enabled and ≥ 1 policy on day 1. TypeScript types generated and committed.

---

## Tables

### `partner_organizations`

```sql
CREATE TABLE partner_organizations (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id),
  type text NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('venue_owner','real_estate','restaurant','cafe','nightclub','event_host','sponsor','photographer','dj','band','catering','bar_service','security','transportation','flowers','marketing','legal','other')),
  business_name text NOT NULL,
  description text,
  address text,
  neighborhood text,
  city text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Medellín',
  phone text,
  website text,
  instagram text,
  profile_completion_pct integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (profile_completion_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft','pending_review','active','suspended')),
  settings jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
ALTER TABLE partner_organizations ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "owner_all" ON partner_organizations FOR ALL USING (user_id = auth.uid());
CREATE POLICY "public_read_active" ON partner_organizations FOR SELECT USING (status = 'active');
```

### `partner_drafts`

```sql
CREATE TABLE partner_drafts (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id),
  partner_id uuid REFERENCES partner_organizations(id),
  step integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  payload jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',  -- all wizard field values
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'in_progress' CHECK (status IN ('in_progress','submitted','abandoned')),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
ALTER TABLE partner_drafts ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "owner_all" ON partner_drafts FOR ALL USING (user_id = auth.uid());
```

### `partner_services`

```sql
CREATE TABLE partner_services (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  partner_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES partner_organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name text NOT NULL,
  description text,
  price_from integer,  -- COP cents
  price_to integer,    -- COP cents
  unit text,           -- 'hour', 'event', 'month', 'person'
  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

ALTER TABLE partner_services ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "owner_all" ON partner_services FOR ALL
  USING (partner_id IN (SELECT id FROM partner_organizations WHERE user_id = auth.uid()));
CREATE POLICY "public_read" ON partner_services FOR SELECT USING (is_active = true);
```

### `partner_locations`

```sql
CREATE TABLE partner_locations (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  partner_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES partner_organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name text,

  neighborhood text,
  lat double precision,

ALTER TABLE partner_locations ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "owner_all" ON partner_locations FOR ALL

CREATE POLICY "public_read" ON partner_locations FOR SELECT USING (true);
```

### `partner_assets`

```sql
CREATE TABLE partner_assets (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  partner_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES partner_organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  type text NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('photo','logo','menu','document','video')),
  url text NOT NULL,

ALTER TABLE partner_assets ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "owner_all" ON partner_assets FOR ALL
  USING (partner_id IN (SELECT id FROM partner_organizations WHERE user_id = auth.uid()));
CREATE POLICY "public_read" ON partner_assets FOR SELECT USING (true);
```

### `partner_leads`

```sql
CREATE TABLE partner_leads (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  partner_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES partner_organizations(id),
  consumer_user_id uuid REFERENCES auth.users(id),
  consumer_name text NOT NULL,
  consumer_email text,
  consumer_phone text,
  inquiry_text text NOT NULL,
  event_date date,
  budget_cop integer,

  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

ALTER TABLE partner_leads ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "owner_read_write" ON partner_leads FOR ALL
  USING (partner_id IN (SELECT id FROM partner_organizations WHERE user_id = auth.uid()));

  USING (consumer_user_id = auth.uid());
```

```sql
CREATE TABLE partner_members (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  partner_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES partner_organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id),

  UNIQUE (partner_id, user_id)

ALTER TABLE partner_members ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "member_read" ON partner_members FOR SELECT
  USING (partner_id IN (SELECT id FROM partner_organizations WHERE user_id = auth.uid()));
```

### `revenue_ledger`

```sql
CREATE TABLE revenue_ledger (

  partner_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES partner_organizations(id),

  reference_id uuid,         -- booking_id or lead_id

ALTER TABLE revenue_ledger ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "owner_all" ON revenue_ledger FOR ALL
  USING (partner_id IN (SELECT id FROM partner_organizations WHERE user_id = auth.uid()));
```

### `partner_notifications`

```sql
CREATE TABLE partner_notifications (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  partner_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES partner_organizations(id),
  lead_id uuid REFERENCES partner_leads(id),
  type text NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('new_lead','booking_request','booking_update','follow_up_reminder','system')),
  title text NOT NULL,
  body text,
  read_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
ALTER TABLE partner_notifications ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "owner_all" ON partner_notifications FOR ALL
  USING (partner_id IN (SELECT id FROM partner_organizations WHERE user_id = auth.uid()));
```

---

## TypeScript types

```bash
supabase gen types typescript --project-id zkwcbyxiwklihegjhuql > src/lib/supabase/types-generated.ts
```

Manual types file `src/lib/types/partner.ts` — re-exports + hand-written form types for wizard payload.

---

## Completion score RPC

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION compute_partner_completion_pct(p_partner_id uuid)
RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
DECLARE score integer := 0;
BEGIN
  SELECT
    (CASE WHEN business_name IS NOT NULL THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN description IS NOT NULL AND length(description) >= 100 THEN 15 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN address IS NOT NULL THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN phone IS NOT NULL THEN 5 ELSE 0 END) +
    (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 3 THEN 20 ELSE (COUNT(*) * 6)::integer END FROM partner_assets WHERE partner_id = p_partner_id AND type = 'photo') +
    (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 1 THEN 15 ELSE 0 END FROM partner_services WHERE partner_id = p_partner_id AND is_active = true) +
    (SELECT CASE WHEN price_per_hour IS NOT NULL THEN 15 ELSE 0 END FROM partner_locations WHERE partner_id = p_partner_id LIMIT 1) +
    (SELECT CASE WHEN availability != '{}' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END FROM partner_locations WHERE partner_id = p_partner_id LIMIT 1)
  INTO score
  FROM partner_organizations WHERE id = p_partner_id;
  RETURN COALESCE(score, 0);
END;
$$;
```

Called on draft save + profile edit to keep `profile_completion_pct` current.

---

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All 9 tables created with correct types and constraints
- [ ] Every table has `ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY` + ≥ 1 policy
- [ ] TypeScript types generated and committed to `src/lib/supabase/types-generated.ts`
- [ ] `compute_partner_completion_pct` RPC created and tested
- [ ] Migration file under `supabase/migrations/`
- [ ] Vitest: RLS policies tested with anon vs authenticated calls
- [ ] No migration runs `DROP TABLE` or `ALTER COLUMN` on existing tables

* CRM-002 (signup writes to partner_organizations + partner_drafts)
* CRM-003 (wizard writes to partner_drafts.payload)
* CRM-009 (health score reads these tables)

Title: PTR-AI-004 — AI Partner Workspace: Copilot Sidebar as primary partner experience
Description:
## PTR-AI-004 — AI Partner Workspace: Copilot Sidebar as primary partner experience

**Goal:** Replace the current forms/widgets paradigm with a persistent `CopilotSidebar` that lets partners ask natural language questions about their business and get AI-powered, actionable responses. This is the highest-leverage AI surface in the entire Partners domain.

---

## Concept

The partner dashboard stops being a passive metrics screen. Instead, the Copilot Sidebar is always accessible — partners ask questions and get grounded answers with deeplinks:

> "Why are my leads down this week?"
> → "Your response rate dropped to 40% (from 82% last week). Two leads from Fri–Sat went unanswered 48h+. Reply now: \[Lead from Camila\] \[Lead from Roberto\]"

> "Should I lower my venue price for January?"
> → "Similar venues in El Poblado with 15% lower prices saw 2.3× more bookings in Jan 2025. Your current occupancy is 34% — a $90/hr rate (from $120) may optimize revenue."

> "What should I do first today?"
> → Needs Attention summary with direct action links

---

## CopilotKit implementation

```tsx
// src/components/partner/PartnerWorkspace.tsx
import { CopilotSidebar } from "@copilotkit/react-ui";

export function PartnerWorkspace({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <CopilotSidebar
      defaultOpen={false}
      labels={{
        title: "Partner AI",
        placeholder: "Ask about your business...",
      }}
      instructions={partnerSidebarInstructions}
    >
      {children}
    </CopilotSidebar>
  );
}
```

* Wraps `/partner/**` layout — sidebar available on all partner pages
* `instructions` injected with: partner type, health score, top 3 needs-attention items, revenue summary
* `useCopilotReadable` provides live context: current page, partner profile, recent leads, revenue snapshot

---

## Suggested Actions chip bar

Below the sidebar input, show 3 suggested action chips that update based on `partnerAgent` context:

```tsx
// chips regenerated on each sidebar open via suggest_partner_actions tool
useCopilotAction({
  name: "suggest_partner_actions",
  available: "disabled",
  render: ({ result }) => <SuggestedActionsBar actions={result.actions} />,
});
```

Default chips (before personalization):

* "What should I focus on today?"
* "How are my leads performing?"
* "Show my revenue this month"

---

## Context injection via `useCopilotReadable`

```tsx
useCopilotReadable({
  description: "Current partner profile and business state",
  value: {
    partnerType: partner.type,
    healthScore: healthScore.score,
    healthTier: healthScore.tier,
    pendingLeads: leads.filter(l => l.status === "pending").length,
    pendingBookings: bookings.filter(b => b.status === "pending").length,
    revenueThisMonth: revenue.current30d,
    revenueTrend: revenue.trend,
  },
});
```

---

## `partnerAgent` tools exposed to workspace

All existing tools are available in sidebar context. Key ones:

* `get_needs_attention` → "What needs my attention?"
* `compute_health_score` → "How is my business doing?"
* `get_revenue_insights` → "How is my revenue?"
* `score_leads` → "Which leads should I prioritize?"
* `suggest_price_adjustment` → "Should I change my pricing?"
* `draft_lead_reply` → "Help me reply to this lead"

---

## `ask_partner_ai` catch-all tool

For questions that don't map to a structured tool, a catch-all Gemini call with full context:

```ts
ask_partner_ai({
  question: string,
  context: PartnerContext,
})
// Returns: { answer: string, actions: ActionLink[] }
```

Actions are rendered as inline chips in the sidebar response bubble.

---

## Mobile

On mobile, `CopilotSidebar` becomes `CopilotPopup` — FAB bottom-right, same tools.

---

- [ ] `CopilotSidebar` wraps `/partner/**` layout, opens/closes without layout shift
- [ ] `useCopilotReadable` injects partner state on every partner page
- [ ] Suggested Actions bar renders 3 chips on sidebar open
- [ ] `ask_partner_ai` answers free-form questions with grounded responses
- [ ] Structured tools (health, leads, revenue) invocable from natural language
- [ ] Mobile: `CopilotPopup` FAB renders correctly on `/partner/**`
- [ ] No CopilotKit v2 imports — v1 only (`@copilotkit/react-ui@1.55.2`)

Title: PTR-AI-003 — Business health score widget (MVP)
Description:
## PTR-AI-003 — Business health score widget (MVP)

**Goal:** Composite 0–100 score that gives a partner an instant, honest signal of how their business is performing on the platform. MVP priority — shown prominently on the dashboard before revenue intelligence.

---

## Score formula

| Signal | Weight | Source |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Profile completion | 25% | `partner_organizations.profile_completion_pct` |
| Lead velocity (leads/7d vs prior 7d) | 25% | `partner_leads` query |
| Response rate (replies within 24h) | 20% | `partner_leads` message timestamps |
| Revenue trend (30d vs prior 30d) | 20% | `revenue_ledger` |
| Listing quality score (photos ≥ 5, description ≥ 200 chars) | 10% | `partner_assets` + `partner_organizations` |

**Score tiers:**

* 80–100: "Thriving" (green)
* 60–79: "Growing" (amber)
* 40–59: "Needs work" (orange)
* 0–39: "At risk" (red)

---

## Mastra tool

```ts
// partnerAgent tool: compute_health_score
// Returns: { score: number, tier: string, breakdown: Record<string, number>, top_recommendation: string }
compute_health_score({ partner_id: string })
```

Gemini generates `top_recommendation` as a single-sentence next action from the breakdown.

---

## CopilotKit wiring

```tsx
useCopilotAction({
  name: "compute_health_score",
  available: "disabled",
  render: ({ result }) => (
    <HealthScoreWidget
      score={result.score}
      tier={result.tier}
      breakdown={result.breakdown}
      recommendation={result.top_recommendation}
    />
  ),
});
```

---

## `HealthScoreWidget` component

* Circular progress ring (score / 100) with tier color
* Expandable: click → breakdown by signal with individual bars
* `top_recommendation` shown below ring as one-line AI tip with deeplink
* Trend badge: "+5 vs last week" / "-3 vs last week"
* Skeleton on load

---

## Supabase

`compute_health_score` is a Supabase RPC function (or computed in the Mastra tool via direct query) — no new table required. Uses existing `partner_organizations`, `partner_leads`, `revenue_ledger`.

RLS: tool called from server-side `partnerAgent` with user identity verified first (F13 carve-out pattern).

---

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Score computes correctly against all 5 signals
- [ ] Tier label + color matches thresholds
- [ ] `top_recommendation` generated by Gemini from breakdown
- [ ] Circular ring renders with correct color and animation (respects `prefers-reduced-motion`)
- [ ] Expandable breakdown shows 5 bars
- [ ] Trend badge shows delta vs prior week
- [ ] Skeleton on load
- [ ] Vitest: score formula edge cases (all 0, all 100, mixed)
- [ ] Playwright: widget visible on `/partner/dashboard` for seeded partner

---

Title: CRM-010 — Notifications system (table, bell, types, mark-read)
Description:
## CRM-010 — Notifications system (table, bell, types, mark-read)

**Goal:** Partner-facing notification feed backed by `partner_notifications` table (created in CRM-001). Bell icon in dashboard header with unread count badge. 5 notification types wired to real system events.

> Phase 2 note: SAN-806 (PTR-AI-007) will add AI follow-up draft notifications. SAN-801 (PTR-AI-002) will add the "Needs Attention" AI panel on top of this foundation.

---

## Notification types

| Type | Trigger | Title template |
| -- | -- | -- |
| `new_lead` | New `partner_leads` row inserted | "New inquiry from \[consumer_name\]" |
| `booking_request` | New `venue_bookings` row inserted | "\[consumer_name\] requested a booking for \[date\]" |
| `booking_update` | Booking status changed | "Booking \[approved / rejected / cancelled\] by \[consumer_name\]" |
| `follow_up_reminder` | Lead > 24h with status `new` | "\[consumer_name\]'s inquiry is 24h old" |
| `system` | Admin broadcasts | system message |

---

## Trigger implementations

### `new_lead`

Insert on `POST /api/partner/leads/[id]/create` (or via Supabase DB trigger on `partner_leads`):

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION notify_new_lead() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO partner_notifications (partner_id, lead_id, type, title, body)
  VALUES (NEW.partner_id, NEW.id, 'new_lead',
    'New inquiry from ' || NEW.consumer_name,
    LEFT(NEW.inquiry_text, 100));
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
CREATE TRIGGER tr_new_lead_notify
  AFTER INSERT ON partner_leads
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION notify_new_lead();
```

### `booking_request`

Similar DB trigger on `venue_bookings INSERT`.

### `follow_up_reminder`

```ts
// GET /api/cron/follow-up-check (protected by CRON_SECRET header)

  .from("partner_leads")
  .select("id, partner_id, consumer_name, last_message_at")
  .eq("status", "new")
  .lt("last_message_at", new Date(Date.now() - 24 * 3600000).toISOString())

  });

    .update({ follow_up_sent_at: new Date().toISOString() })
    .eq("id", lead.id);
}
```

Title: CRM-009 — Health score calculation (server-side, no AI, 5-signal composite)
Description:
## CRM-009 — Health score calculation (server-side, no AI, 5-signal composite)

**Goal:** A pure server-side Supabase RPC (no Gemini) that computes a 0–100 composite health score from 5 data signals. Exposed as an API endpoint and displayed in the dashboard widget. Tier label and color only — no AI narrative.

> Phase 2 note: SAN-802 (PTR-AI-003) will add Gemini-generated recommendation, circular progress ring animation, and breakdown visualization on top of this foundation.

---

## 5-signal formula

| Signal | Weight | Computation |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Profile completion | 25% | `partner_organizations.profile_completion_pct` / 100 |
| Lead velocity | 25% | leads in last 7d vs prior 7d — normalized 0–1 (no regression = 0.5, +100% = 1.0, -100% = 0) |
| Response rate | 20% | `partner_leads WHERE status IN ('replied','booked') / total leads last 30d` |
| Revenue trend | 20% | current 30d vs prior 30d pctChange — normalized: flat = 0.5, +50% = 1.0, -50% = 0 |
| Listing quality | 10% | photos ≥ 5 (0.5 pts), description ≥ 200 chars (0.3 pts), phone set (0.2 pts) |

Final score = `ROUND(weighted_sum * 100)`.

---

## Supabase RPC: `compute_health_score`

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION compute_health_score(p_partner_id uuid)
RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
DECLARE
  profile_pct integer;
  lead_velocity numeric;
  response_rate numeric;
  revenue_trend numeric;
  listing_quality numeric;
  final_score integer;
  tier text;
BEGIN
  -- profile completion
  SELECT profile_completion_pct INTO profile_pct
  FROM partner_organizations WHERE id = p_partner_id;

  -- lead velocity: leads this 7d vs prior 7d
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN prior_count = 0 THEN 0.6
      ELSE LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(0.0, 0.5 + (current_count::numeric - prior_count) / (2.0 * GREATEST(prior_count, 1))))
    END INTO lead_velocity
  FROM (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS current_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at BETWEEN NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' AND NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS prior_count
    FROM partner_leads WHERE partner_id = p_partner_id
  ) t;

  -- response rate
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN total = 0 THEN 0.5
    ELSE replied::numeric / total END INTO response_rate
  FROM (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*) AS total,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('replied','booked')) AS replied
    FROM partner_leads
    WHERE partner_id = p_partner_id AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  ) t;

  -- revenue trend
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN prior_rev = 0 THEN 0.5
      ELSE LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(0.0, 0.5 + (current_rev - prior_rev)::numeric / (2.0 * GREATEST(prior_rev, 1))))
    END INTO revenue_trend
  FROM (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE ledger_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 30), 0) AS current_rev,
      COALESCE(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE ledger_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - 60 AND CURRENT_DATE - 30), 0) AS prior_rev
    FROM revenue_ledger WHERE partner_id = p_partner_id
  ) t;

  -- listing quality
  SELECT
    (CASE WHEN photo_count >= 5 THEN 0.5 WHEN photo_count >= 3 THEN 0.3 ELSE 0.0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN desc_len >= 200 THEN 0.3 WHEN desc_len >= 100 THEN 0.15 ELSE 0.0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN has_phone THEN 0.2 ELSE 0.0 END)
  INTO listing_quality
  FROM (
    SELECT
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM partner_assets WHERE partner_id = p_partner_id AND type = 'photo') AS photo_count,
      COALESCE(LENGTH(description), 0) AS desc_len,
      (phone IS NOT NULL) AS has_phone
    FROM partner_organizations WHERE id = p_partner_id
  ) t;

  final_score := ROUND(
    profile_pct * 0.0025 +      -- 25% of 100
    lead_velocity * 25 +
    response_rate * 20 +
    revenue_trend * 20 +
    listing_quality * 10
  );

  tier := CASE
    WHEN final_score >= 80 THEN 'Thriving'
    WHEN final_score >= 60 THEN 'Growing'
    WHEN final_score >= 40 THEN 'Needs work'
    ELSE 'At risk'
  END;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'score', final_score,
    'tier', tier,
    'breakdown', jsonb_build_object(
      'profile_completion', ROUND(profile_pct * 0.0025),
      'lead_velocity', ROUND(lead_velocity * 25),
      'response_rate', ROUND(response_rate * 20),
      'revenue_trend', ROUND(revenue_trend * 20),
      'listing_quality', ROUND(listing_quality * 10)
    )
  );
END;
$$;
```

```
GET /api/partner/[id]/health-score
→ { score: number, tier: string, breakdown: Record<string, number> }
```

Called on dashboard load and after any lead reply, booking approve, or profile edit.

**Goal:** `/partner/bookings` page where venue owners and rental partners manage booking requests. Approve, reject, or counter with a manually entered counter-price. No AI counter-offer suggestions — that's Phase 2 (SAN-804, PTR-AI-005).

## Scope

Applies to partner types with `capabilities.bookings = true`: `venue_owner`, `real_estate`, `nightclub`, `event_host`.

Other partner types (restaurant, café, sponsor etc.) see "Bookings not applicable to your account type" and a redirect to leads.

---

## Route: `/partner/bookings` + `/partner/bookings/[id]`

### Booking list

* Filter tabs: Pending / Approved / Rejected / Countered / Completed / Cancelled
* Each booking card: consumer name, requested date, requested hours, total price, status badge
* Sorted by requested date (ascending)

### Booking detail `/partner/bookings/[id]`

Booking info section:

* Consumer: name, contact
* Requested: date, start time, end time, number of guests
* Requested price: $X,XXX
* Notes from consumer

Action panel (right):

* **Approve** button → status `approved`, writes `revenue_ledger` entry
* **Reject** button → status `rejected`, optional rejection note
* **Counter** button → opens counter form: new price (COP) + message → status `countered`

---

## Booking state machine

```
pending → approved  (write revenue_ledger row)
pending → rejected
pending → countered
countered → approved  (if consumer accepts counter)
countered → rejected  (if consumer rejects counter)
approved → completed  (after event date passes — cron or manual)
approved → cancelled  (before event date)
```

---

## Supabase: `venue_bookings` table

```sql
CREATE TABLE venue_bookings (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  partner_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES partner_organizations(id),
  lead_id uuid REFERENCES partner_leads(id),
  consumer_user_id uuid REFERENCES auth.users(id),
  consumer_name text NOT NULL,
  requested_date date NOT NULL,
  time_start time NOT NULL,
  time_end time NOT NULL,
  guests integer,
  requested_price_cop integer NOT NULL,
  counter_price_cop integer,
  counter_message text,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
    CHECK (status IN ('pending','approved','rejected','countered','completed','cancelled')),
  rejection_note text,
  idempotency_key text UNIQUE,  -- sha256(partner_id||consumer_id||date||time_start)
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
ALTER TABLE venue_bookings ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "partner_all" ON venue_bookings FOR ALL
  USING (partner_id IN (SELECT id FROM partner_organizations WHERE user_id = auth.uid()));
CREATE POLICY "consumer_read_own" ON venue_bookings FOR SELECT
  USING (consumer_user_id = auth.uid());
```

Idempotency key prevents double-booking on retry (sha256 of partner+consumer+date+time).

---

```
GET  /api/partner/[id]/bookings              → paginated list
GET  /api/partner/bookings/[bookingId]       → booking detail

POST /api/partner/bookings/[bookingId]/counter  { price: number, message: string }
```

```ts
  partner_id: booking.partner_id,
```

Scoring signals:

* Inquiry budget vs partner's typical deal size
* Event/booking date proximity (urgent = higher score)

```tsx

  name: "draft_lead_reply",
  available: "disabled",

      onEdit={(edited) => respond({ action: "send", text: edited })}
      onDiscard={() => respond({ action: "discard" })}
    />
  ),
});
```

---

## Booking counter-offer HITL

### `suggest_counter_offer` tool

When a booking request comes in with a budget below the partner's floor price:

```ts
suggest_counter_offer({
  booking_request_id: string,
  partner_floor_price: number,
  requested_price: number,
})
// Returns: { suggested_counter: number, rationale: string, message_draft: string }
```

Counter-offer card blocks agent until partner approves/edits:

```tsx
useCopilotAction({
  name: "suggest_counter_offer",
  available: "disabled",
  render: ({ result, respond }) => (
    <CounterOfferCard
      suggestedPrice={result.suggested_counter}
      rationale={result.rationale}
      messageDraft={result.message_draft}
      onAccept={() => respond({ action: "send_counter", price: result.suggested_counter })}
      onEdit={(p, m) => respond({ action: "send_counter", price: p, message: m })}
      onDecline={() => respond({ action: "decline" })}
    />
  ),
});
```

---

## Supabase

No new tables. Reads `partner_leads`, `partner_services`, `partner_locations`. Writes back to `partner_leads` on send/decline. All reads through `partnerAgent` server-side with verified identity (F13 carve-out).

## Summary

When a partner types their business name on step 1 of the signup wizard, `partnerAgent` calls Places API New (`searchText`) and pre-fills address, neighborhood, business type, rating, and opening hours into the wizard form. Removes the biggest friction point in onboarding — no manual address entry.

## Done when

- [ ] Wizard step 1 has a "Business name" field; after 300ms debounce, calls `prefill_business_profile(name, city="Medellín")` Mastra tool
- [ ] Tool calls Places API New `searchText` with `X-Goog-FieldMask: places.id,places.displayName,places.formattedAddress,places.location,places.types,places.regularOpeningHours,places.rating`
- [ ] Top result pre-fills: `partner_drafts.payload.address`, `.neighborhood`, `.lat`, `.lng`, `.type` (mapped from Places type), `.rating`
- [ ] `useCopilotAction({ name: "prefill_business_profile", available: "disabled", render })` shows a "We found your business — confirm?" card with \[✅ Use This\] \[✕ Enter Manually\] buttons
- [ ] On confirm: fields locked (gray, non-editable) with "From Google Maps" badge; partner can override with \[Edit\]
- [ ] On skip/manual: fields remain editable; no auto-fill
- [ ] `X-Goog-FieldMask` verified in test — fetch without field mask fails Vitest
- [ ] Works for all 18 partner types — vertical is set from `places.types` mapping table

## Implementation notes

* Places type mapping: `restaurant` → `restaurant`, `lodging` → `rental_host`, `real_estate_agency` → `broker`, `event_venue` → `venue_owner`, fallback → `other`
* Neighborhood mapping: reverse geocode `places.location` against Medellín neighborhood GeoJSON (`public/geojson/medellin-neighborhoods.json`)
* Cache Places result for 24h keyed by `displayName + city` — prevent re-billing on re-opens
* If 0 results: show "No match found — enter manually" inline, no error state
* `partnerAgent` capability flag: `onboarding` — only the onboarding capability set includes this tool

## Critical rules

* `X-Goog-FieldMask` REQUIRED — do not request `photos`, `reviews`, or `websiteUri`
* HITL confirm card REQUIRED before any auto-fill commits — never overwrite fields without user approval
* Blocked by: SAN-705 (partnerAgent), SAN-706 (partner tools), SAN-709 (onboarding copilot)

- [ ] Vitest: `search_partner_business("Pergamino", "Medellín")` returns ≥1 result with `formattedAddress` non-null

Description:
## Goal

Complete the Phase 1 Partner CRM foundation with:

1. Partner settings + account management page (`/partner/settings`)
2. Partner hub index routing (`/partner` → dashboard or onboarding)
3. Background workflow infrastructure (cron endpoint + follow-up scheduler)

No AI, no CopilotKit, no Gemini. Pure server-side logic.

---

## Scope

### `/partner` root page

* Server component that checks `partner_profiles.onboarding_complete`
* If `false` → redirect to `/partner/onboarding`
* If `true` → redirect to `/partner/dashboard`
* Handles unauthenticated → redirect to `/login?next=/partner`

### `/partner/settings` page

**Account section**

* Display name, contact email, phone (editable)
* `PATCH /api/partner/settings/account`

**Notification preferences**

* Toggles per notification type: `new_lead`, `booking_request`, `booking_update`, `follow_up_reminder`
* Stored in `partner_profiles.notification_prefs` (jsonb column — add via migration)
* `PATCH /api/partner/settings/notifications`

**Pricing defaults**

* Minimum booking hours, deposit percentage, cancellation window (days)
* Stored in `partner_profiles.pricing_defaults` (jsonb column — add via migration)
* `PATCH /api/partner/settings/pricing`

**Danger zone**

* "Deactivate account" → sets `partner_profiles.is_active = false`, signs out
* `POST /api/partner/settings/deactivate` — requires `reason` string
* No hard delete in Phase 1

### API routes (all server-only, F13 carve-out applies)

| Route | Method | Auth |
| -- | -- | -- |
| `/api/partner/settings/account` | PATCH | partner session |
| `/api/partner/settings/notifications` | PATCH | partner session |
| `/api/partner/settings/pricing` | PATCH | partner session |
| `/api/partner/settings/deactivate` | POST | partner session |
| `/api/cron/follow-up-check` | GET | `CRON_SECRET` header |

### Cron endpoint — `/api/cron/follow-up-check`

Runs on a schedule (daily at 9am COT). Finds leads where:

* `status = 'new'` AND `created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'`
* No existing `partner_notifications` row with `type = 'follow_up_reminder'` for the same `lead_id`

Creates `partner_notifications` rows + logs to `partner_activity_log` with `action = 'follow_up_reminder_sent'`.

Auth: validates `Authorization: Bearer ${CRON_SECRET}` header — reject with 401 if missing or wrong.

```typescript
// /api/cron/follow-up-check/route.ts (server-only, service-role allowed per F13)
export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const secret = req.headers.get('authorization')?.replace('Bearer ', '');
  if (secret !== process.env.CRON_SECRET) return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 });
  // ... query + insert notifications
}
```

Vercel Cron config in `vercel.json`:

```json
{
  "crons": [{ "path": "/api/cron/follow-up-check", "schedule": "0 14 * * *" }]
}
```

(14:00 UTC = 09:00 COT)

### Supabase migration additions

```sql
-- Add columns to partner_profiles
ALTER TABLE partner_profiles
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS notification_prefs jsonb DEFAULT '{
    "new_lead": true,
    "booking_request": true,
    "booking_update": true,
    "follow_up_reminder": true
  }'::jsonb,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS pricing_defaults jsonb DEFAULT '{
    "min_booking_hours": 3,
    "deposit_pct": 30,
    "cancellation_window_days": 7
  }'::jsonb,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true;

-- Index for cron query
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_partner_leads_cron
  ON partner_leads(partner_id, status, created_at)
  WHERE status = 'new';
```

Title: PTR-AI-007 — Auto follow-up reminder workflow (24/48h nudge with HITL)
Description:
## PTR-AI-007 — Auto follow-up reminder workflow (24/48h nudge with HITL)

**Goal:** Catch unanswered leads before they go cold. A Mastra background workflow monitors `partner_leads` for no-reply situations and surfaces a HITL follow-up reminder with a draft message — the partner sees it in their dashboard and in the CopilotSidebar.

---

## Mastra workflow: `leadFollowUpWorkflow`

```ts
// src/mastra/workflows/leadFollowUpWorkflow.ts
const leadFollowUpWorkflow = createWorkflow({
  id: "lead-follow-up",
  steps: [checkUnansweredLeads, draftFollowUp, notifyPartner, awaitPartnerAction],
});
```

### Steps

1. `checkUnansweredLeads` — scheduled every 4h via Mastra cron:
   * Query `partner_leads WHERE status = 'pending' AND last_message_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'`
   * Emit one job per unanswered lead
2. `draftFollowUp` — Gemini generates contextual follow-up draft:
   * Input: original lead message, partner's service type, time since inquiry
   * Output: `{ draft: string, urgency: "high" | "medium" }` — urgency based on booking date proximity
3. `notifyPartner` — writes to `partner_notifications` table + pushes to CopilotSidebar context:
   * Notification: "Camila's inquiry is 24h old — she may be looking elsewhere"
   * HITL card surfaces in dashboard "Needs Attention" panel (PTR-AI-002)
4. `awaitPartnerAction` — `suspend()` until partner responds:
   * **Approve draft** → send via `partner_leads` message write → mark notified
   * **Edit & send** → send edited version
   * **Snooze 24h** → re-queue job, update `snoozed_until` field
   * **Mark irrelevant** → remove from queue, update `partner_leads.status = 'dismissed'`

48h escalation: if 48h passes with no action, workflow sends once more with higher urgency tag. After that, no further nudges (avoids partner fatigue).

---

## `partner_notifications` table

```sql
CREATE TABLE partner_notifications (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  partner_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES partner_organizations(id),
  lead_id uuid REFERENCES partner_leads(id),
  type text NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('follow_up_24h', 'follow_up_48h', 'booking_pending', 'health_alert')),
  message text NOT NULL,
  draft text,
  snoozed_until timestamptz,
  resolved_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
-- RLS: partner can only see their own notifications
ALTER TABLE partner_notifications ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "partner_own_notifications" ON partner_notifications
  FOR ALL USING (
    partner_id IN (SELECT id FROM partner_organizations WHERE user_id = auth.uid())
  );
```

---

## Bulk message consent guard

* Max 1 follow-up message per lead per 24h window (enforced in `checkUnansweredLeads` step)
* Partner must have opted in to "AI follow-up reminders" in their settings (default: on, with opt-out)
* All sends written to `audit_logs` with `action = 'ai_follow_up_sent'`
* **Never auto-send** — every message goes through HITL before delivery

---

## CopilotKit surface

The follow-up nudge card appears in:

1. Dashboard "Needs Attention" panel (PTR-AI-002) — rendered by `get_needs_attention` tool
2. AI Workspace sidebar (PTR-AI-004) — partnerAgent mentions it in context

When partner opens sidebar and asks "any urgent follow-ups?", agent calls `get_pending_follow_ups(partner_id)` and renders `FollowUpReminderCard` list.

---

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `leadFollowUpWorkflow` runs every 4h and detects leads > 24h unanswered
- [ ] Gemini draft follows context of original inquiry
- [ ] HITL card blocks workflow until partner acts (approve/edit/snooze/dismiss)
- [ ] Snooze re-queues for 24h; dismiss marks lead as irrelevant
- [ ] 48h escalation fires once; no further nudges after that
- [ ] `partner_notifications` table has RLS enabled + policy
- [ ] Opt-out setting respected — no nudges if disabled
- [ ] All sends written to `audit_logs`
- [ ] Vitest: 24/48h timing logic, draft generation mock, snooze re-queue
- [ ] Playwright: follow-up card visible in "Needs Attention" panel, approve flow

---

* SAN-704 (AGT-PTR-01) — `partnerAgent` must exist
* SAN-801 (PTR-AI-002) — "Needs Attention" panel must exist to surface notifications

Title: PTR — POST /api/partners/activate (activate API)
Description:
## Scope (approved 2026-06-07)

Implement activate API only. No dashboard UI. No full signup wizard.

## Approved design decisions

| Decision | Choice | Reason |
| -- | -- | -- |
| `redirectTo` | `/dashboard` | Correct final destination; dashboard shell added separately |
| `draftId` | Optional — link if provided, set `submitted_at` | No auto-link latest draft (risks wrong draft attachment) |
| Duplicate partner | HTTP 200 idempotent with existing `partnerId` | No 409 — caller can safely retry |
| Client-supplied `status`/`tier`/`completion_score` | Stripped/blocked at schema layer | No privilege escalation from client |

## API contract

```
POST /api/partners/activate
Authorization: Bearer <session-token>   (required)

Body:
{
  type: "host" | "venue" | "broker" | "sponsor" | "agency" | "vendor" | "tour" | "creator",
  draftId?: string  // UUID — optional, links draft to partner
}

201 Created  (new partner)
{ partnerId, type, status: "draft", redirectTo: "/dashboard" }

200 OK  (duplicate — partner already exists for this user+type)
{ partnerId, type, status: "draft", redirectTo: "/dashboard" }

400  invalid type / validation failure
401  unauthenticated
404  draftId provided but not found
403  draftId belongs to another user
429  rate limited
503  service role unavailable
```
